text: I had my teeth cleaned today, and the dentist was very kind and gentle. Plus, it's close to my house!

I went to see them about getting aligners, then had my teeth cleaned and three small fillings placed. The orthodontist's consultation went well, but then the whole ordeal began, and I decided I'd better not go back to this clinic to avoid even more problems. Unfortunately, the quality is poor. The entire cleaning and filling procedure took about 20 minutes. The fillings are a different color from my teeth. The cleaning was done sloppily and was extremely painful. My teeth hurt a lot afterwards, and my gums bled. The worst part is that during the cleaning, the dentist removed some enamel from my front tooth (it was pigmented, so she apparently decided to drill it out because professional cleanings can't remove such deep pigment). Now my tooth is sensitive to hot and cold, and the surface of the tooth isn't smooth, which is understandable because it's impossible to simply drill out even a small surface of enamel. In that moment, everything happened so fast that I didn’t even have time to say anything, the only thing I wanted was to run away from there as quickly as possible.
